name: SEOAuto.ai – Bulk AI SEO Pages on Autopilot
author: yunsoft

sections.description:
SEOAuto.ai is a programmatic SEO platform that generates hundreds or thousands of optimised, AI-written pages for your WordPress site — fully automated and ready to publish.

A valid SEOAuto.ai account and API key are required because page generation and site configuration are handled through the external SEOAuto.ai API service.

How it works

  1. Connect — Paste your SEOAuto.ai API key (free account at seoauto.ai).
  2. Setup wizard — Define your keyword structure, page templates and internal link pool. Takes about 90 seconds.
  3. Generate & publish — Hit “Generate”, watch pages appear, then publish them to WordPress with one click.

Features

  • AI-generated, keyword-optimised pages at scale
  • Guided 3-step setup wizard
  • One-click publish / unpublish directly to WordPress
  • Automatic SEO meta (Yoast & RankMath compatible)
  • Multi-language support
  • Custom banner image gallery per site
  • Dashboard with generation status tracking

Requirements

  • A free or paid SEOAuto.ai account
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • WordPress 5.9 or higher

Third-Party Services

This plugin communicates with the SEOAuto.ai external API service to perform all AI page generation, account management, and site configuration.

The service is contacted when you connect your API key, complete the setup wizard, generate pages, poll generation progress, and publish generated pages to WordPress.

What data is transmitted

  • Your site URL and active theme colour palette (sent during the setup wizard)
  • The internal page URLs you manually enter in the plugin settings
  • Requests to generate, retrieve, or publish SEO pages

No personally identifiable information about your site visitors is ever collected or transmitted.

Service details

  • Service name: SEOAuto.ai
  • Service URL: https://seoauto.ai
  • Privacy Policy: https://seoauto.ai/privacy
  • Terms of Service: https://seoauto.ai/terms

By using this plugin you agree to the SEOAuto.ai Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the seoauto-ai folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu.
  3. Go to SEOAuto.ai in the WordPress admin sidebar.
  4. Paste your API key from seoauto.ai and follow the setup wizard.
sections.faq:
Do I need a SEOAuto.ai account?

Yes. The plugin communicates with the SEOAuto.ai API which requires an account. A free tier is available at seoauto.ai.

Does this plugin store my API key?

Your API key is stored securely in your WordPress database using the standard WordPress Options API. It is never exposed publicly.

What data is sent to SEOAuto.ai servers?

When you run the setup wizard, the plugin sends your site URL, primary colour palette (read from your active theme’s CSS), and the internal page URLs you manually provide. No personal user data is collected.

Is this plugin compatible with Gutenberg?

Yes. Published pages use the standard WordPress post_content field and are fully viewable in the block editor.

Does it work with Yoast SEO or RankMath?

Yes. When publishing a page the plugin automatically writes SEO title and meta description to both Yoast and RankMath meta fields if those plugins are active.
